task_transfer.output: Model wire output nests evidence within each selected label. Deterministic encoding produces the unchanged canonical label_ids/explanation/evidence/bullet_ids fields, retaining all model-selected labels and quotes. Coding and insufficient_context are mutually exclusive schema branches. No label is guessed, dropped, or repaired using GT.
task_transfer.miprov2: Pinned DSPy MIPROv2 with the installed module AST recorded in optimizer_pins. Proposal and task generation both use the common native runtime through a single-output local LM; no external provider client is constructed. Candidate selection replaces the per-item bootstrap metric with a full-development corpus F1 objective, macro for Dreaddit and micro for GoEmotions, evaluated over the complete development split on every trial. Minibatching is disabled. A candidate whose learned context exceeds eight demonstrations or 4096 tokenizer tokens is rejected without shortened demonstrations and without model calls.
task_transfer.gt: Train and development GT are read during optimization only. The selected program is frozen and hashed before any evaluation input is read, and no evaluation GT reaches prediction.
task_transfer.memory: The learned context is bounded by the shared 4096-tokenizer-token budget that applies to the Base/ICL and adaptation runtimes.
task_transfer.failures: Exhausted format failures are recorded as invalid evaluation outputs and evaluation continues. An invalid development candidate scores zero rather than gaining from abstention. No test-output repair.
task_transfer.restart: Immutable per-item evaluation commits, a saved compiled program and a request cache resume a run without repeating optimization.
task_transfer.dependencies: Only the installed pinned DSPy optimizer executes; provider initializers, dotenv and external-client imports do not execute.
task_transfer.concurrency: Independent one-GPU streams, one request at a time per stream; throughput profile, not single-GPU reference timing.

predecessor: Base/ICL prediction stage and adaptation r3/r4/r5; no trajectory or score is imported
development_gate: Both seed-42 conditions must complete six development sources end to end, with a compiled program and six valid predictions, before any production seed run is admitted.
